note: Canonical backlog for the control-room slices, derived from IMPLEMENTATION_SLICES and IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER in the plan. Order follows the plan's IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER verbatim. declaredStatus is a CLAIM that is believed only when its completionEvidence exists on disk; dependencies and prerequisites are evaluated mechanically by scripts/claude-loop/backlog.ts. External prerequisites name backend slices in Nortropic/nortropic-system, which this repository is not the authority for and cannot measure: they stay unmet until an owner records a measurement in the runtime evidence file under the Git common directory. No slice here is described as live-complete against fixtures.

items.title: Live read plane
items.summary: Real snapshots and events from the control-plane Supabase, with zero writes from Verkstadsgolvet and gap detection only on the unfiltered store stream.

prerequisites.note: operations/lifecycle-event store built and green, carrying B3's locked seq scope and B4's canonical payload contract
controller/lucka read projection publishing the B8 controller-generated snapshot (BACKEND_CROSS_PLAN_REQUIREMENT_FOR_S13)

task.description: Implement V4 exactly as the plan defines it. The app performs zero writes against loop_events/loop_snapshots, never resolves origin/main itself, never reconstructs authoritative state by event fold, and adds no /api/loop route to the middleware matcher exemptions. Every /api/loop handler calls auth() itself. Unknown or unavailable backend data renders as an em dash, never invented data.

items.title: Task inspector
items.summary: Eleven inspector tabs where a tab without backend data shows an em dash with a reason and NOT_RUN renders visually distinct from PASS.

prerequisites.note: per-task gate verdict (h-017) built with proofs, needed by the verification tabs
structured failure feedback, needed by the ATTEMPTS tab

task.description: Implement V5 exactly as the plan defines it. No tab ever renders gate code, control names or the registry. A verdict is always rendered against its own candidate_sha and never inherited.

items.title: Markdown intake UI against fixtures
items.summary: The intake surface (/loop/mata, dropzone and result rendering) built and proven against generated fixtures only, with no live transport and no server intake route.

task.description: Build the intake UI against generated fixtures only. This slice is FIXTURE-ONLY and is never live-complete: it must not create app/api/loop/intake, must not talk to any transport, must not compute a trusted hash and must not compile tasks in the frontend. The client rejects non-.md files and enforces size/count limits; a fixture backend rejection is rendered verbatim; NEEDS_SPEC renders as a working state and never as an error. The live counterpart V8 stays blocked on nortropic-system S10 + S13 (B5), which own the transport form.

items.title: Narrow command surface
items.summary: Exactly the five typed operator intents, idempotent by command_id, with no optimistic state and no lease/breaker/ref/verdict/attestation/promotion code path.

prerequisites.note: controller/lucka built AND verified; a command queue without a built claimer is a queue without a claimer

task.description: Implement V7 exactly as the plan defines it. Exactly five verbs; a sixth returns 400 with no side effect. A command is only an intention and the controller may always reject it. No optimistic UI state: task state changes only from a snapshot. Zero code paths under app/api/loop/** and lib/loop/** touching lease, breaker, Git refs, verdict, attestation or promotion, and no GitHub credential of any kind.

items.title: Markdown intake live
items.summary: The same intake UI against the real narrow intake transport, where Verkstadsgolvet's sha256 is only a claim and the controller recomputes and rejects on mismatch.

prerequisites.note: controller/intag Markdown intake and Task IR
B5 source_ref transport form is owned there, not here

task.description: Implement live V8 exactly as the plan defines it. The app's hash is never a trust anchor; a tampered transport byte must produce a controller rejection rather than an accepted source. The frontend never compiles tasks and never estimates a task count before the controller answers.

items.title: Realtime, reconnect and dedup
items.summary: SSE tail with reconnect and backfill that never duplicates or loses events, dedup on event_id, and a visible poll fallback.

prerequisites.note: the operations event store is the only source of a real tail

task.description: Implement V9 exactly as the plan defines it. An unknown future event_type renders raw without crashing, a newer major schema_version shows a banner, and the UI never claims realtime while it is polling.

items.title: Security hardening
items.summary: Statically measured: no secrets in the client bundle, no NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables, an unchanged middleware matcher and no GitHub credential reachable from any loop path.

task.description: Implement V10 exactly as the plan defines it. The middleware matcher must stay byte-identical to the one at PLAN_BASE_SHA. Prove statically: zero imports of lib/github-read.ts or lib/github-write.ts under app/api/loop/** and lib/loop/**, and zero code paths there touching lease, breaker, Git refs, verdict, attestation or promotion.

items.title: Responsive polish and regressions
items.summary: 1280/960/720/375 px without horizontal page scroll, reduced motion respected, and every existing surface still green.

task.description: Implement V11 exactly as the plan defines it. app/globals.css changes are additive only; wide surfaces scroll in their own container; / must render identically to PLAN_BASE_SHA.

items.title: Merge resolution UX
items.summary: The seven merge states rendered from their event types, where B's PASS is never shown as D's verdict and conflict/resolver-working never render as a human stop.

prerequisites.note: merge resolution, which must itself prove candidate=D with parent_sha=C (B7)

task.description: Implement V6 exactly as the plan defines it. Never derive parentage from GitHub, never reuse an old verdict for a resolved candidate, and offer no 'resolve the conflict' button.
